description: This file defines React hooks and types for fetching and managing API resources, including resource state management, transformation, and API call handling within a Superset frontend project.

methods.name: useApiResourceFullBody
methods.description: A React hook to fetch data from an API endpoint, managing loading, success, and error states.

methods.name: useTransformedResource
methods.description: Transforms the result of a resource hook with a provided function, handling errors during transformation.

methods.name: useApiV1Resource
methods.description: Fetches a resource from a v1 API endpoint, returning the 'result' field from the response.
